resources.name: Fleet card (default CSP)
resources.description: Fleet comparison card. Declares NO ui.csp, so a spec-compliant host must apply the restrictive default policy.

resources.name: Fleet card (declared CSP)
resources.description: Byte-identical widget, but declares connectDomains and resourceDomains so the host should widen the policy to exactly those origins.

tools.name: fleet_status
tools.title: Fleet status (text only)
tools.description: Single-value answer. Per the article's rule, a status is a sentence, not a card — so this tool carries no _meta.ui.

tools.name: browse_fleet
tools.title: Browse fleet (widget, default CSP)
tools.description: List unicorns. Comparison shape, so it renders a card. Uses the resource that declares no CSP.

available_only.description: Only return unicorns that are currently available.

tools.name: browse_fleet_permissive
tools.title: Browse fleet (widget, declared CSP)
tools.description: Identical to browse_fleet, but points at the resource that declares connectDomains and resourceDomains.
